comment: Menu item names read from the plugin's own source. Clarity's menu is Colour and rule sets alone; TestGear's is Show diagnostics…, which reads Hide diagnostics while the window is open; Dark's census commands appear only behind a file check and get no line. Scroll wheel adjusts sliders is param 7 and has no widget and no menu item, so it can never be clicked: the line for it moved from Menu to Note. Clarity's help switch is param 10, off by default, and the modifier is option on the Mac and Alt elsewhere; the lines say option. NOTE FOR A PERSON: research/help/census/DreamerDevelopment.json is stale — it lists the help switch on Dark and gives Clarity ten params, where the source has eleven with the help switch as Clarity's own. The tags here follow the source. Regenerate the census before the next pass.
